context_requirements: Expression of a functional urease enzyme; human cells lack urease, so no direct target is present
Presence of urea as a nitrogen source; standard culture media do not rely on urea assimilation
Urea transporter activity (e.g., DUR3/SLC14A2) if any indirect effect were to occur
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of urea-cycle, nitrogen-metabolism, or ammonia-detoxification transcriptional programs
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls

evidence.supports: The urease inhibitor NBPT affects urea uptake and assimilation in plants, but the effect requires urea as a nitrogen source and a functional urea transport/assimilation system; human cells lack urease and do not depend on urea assimilation.
